verdict.rationale: AMD documents Linux x86-64 support for the RX 9070 XT, ships the amdgpu driver bundled with ROCm for Radeon, and describes ROCm as a primarily open-source stack that can be built from source. However, no evidence explicitly states that the amdgpu kernel driver is open-source or upstreamed in the mainline Linux kernel. Missing for 10: explicit vendor documentation that the kernel driver is open-source or upstream, and independent hands-on corroboration of running on the open driver.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run this GPU on an open driver — open-source kernel modules or upstream Linux support documented by the vendor
